What this tower covers

IoT, Digital Twin & Robotics bridges the physical and digital enterprise: industrial sensor network, digital twin platforms, computer vision and edge AI, predictive maintenance, robotics and autonomous systems integration, connected products, and smart infrastructure. The tower's test is operational: fewer unplanned stoppages, tighter quality distributions, safer floors, and asset performance you can steer from a control tower.

Why this tower, why now

Compute moved to the plant floor and the camera moved into the process. Vision models now read gauges and weld seams; twins simulate line reconfiguration before steel is cut; retrofitted robots pay back in under two years against labor scarcity. Physics-heavy industries that industrialized this stack are compounding an operational advantage that software-only competitors cannot copy.
